label: Project country identifier
definition: Stable ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 identifier used to integrate project sources

label: Project country name
definition: Readable project label for the country

label: FAOSTAT country label
definition: Area label retained from the prepared FAOSTAT input
notes: Retained for lineage and comparison with the crosswalk.

label: Year
definition: Calendar year represented by both annual records
notes: The MODIS annual product uses the calendar year beginning on its calendar_date.

label: Maize yield
definition: FAOSTAT maize yield converted to tonnes per hectare

label: Log maize yield
definition: Natural logarithm of positive maize yield
notes: Missing when yield is missing or non-positive.

label: Reference-site NPP
definition: Annual net primary productivity at one documented MODIS pixel
notes: Scale factor 0.0001 applied; not a country average or maize-specific measure.

label: NPP quality-control percentage
definition: Percentage of annual NPP composed of gap-filled 8-day GPP estimates
notes: Retained for interpretation rather than filtered silently.

label: Reference latitude
definition: Latitude of the center of the selected teaching pixel
notes: WGS84 coordinate; deliberately not presented as a national centroid statistic.

label: Reference longitude
definition: Longitude of the center of the selected teaching pixel
notes: WGS84 coordinate; deliberately not presented as a national centroid statistic.

label: MODIS date
definition: Provider date code for the annual composite

label: MODIS tile
definition: Sinusoidal-grid tile containing the reference pixel

label: MODIS processing timestamp
definition: Provider processing identifier for the product granule
